facts.text: UC Santa Cruz features a distinctive system of residential colleges, which serve as living and learning communities within the university.

sources.title: About UC Santa Cruz
sources.quote: Our system of residential colleges—living and learning communities within the university—provides support for the whole student and makes their success a priority.

facts.text: Every undergraduate student at UC Santa Cruz belongs to one of its 10 residential colleges.

sources.title: Explore the Colleges - UC Santa Cruz
sources.quote: At UC Santa Cruz, every undergraduate student belongs to one of 10 residential colleges.

facts.text: UC Santa Cruz offers an expanded two-year campus housing guarantee for new incoming undergraduate cohorts entering in fall 2026 and later who indicate an on-campus preference.

sources.title: Housing Guarantee - UC Santa Cruz
sources.quote: The expanded 2-year housing guarantee applies to new incoming undergraduate cohorts entering in Fall 2026 and later.
